purpose: The feature walkthrough band of a product page: a left-aligned section title over up to three tabs on one side and the active tab's illustration on the other, closed by a small link under the frame. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'feature-tabs', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `frame-box`, `media-tabs`, `illustration` and `mini-button`. The tabs advance on a timer that pauses under the pointer or keyboard focus and never runs under reduced motion; that state is owned by `media-tabs`.
useWhen: To walk through the two or three features behind one claim, one picture at a time, like Functions' Observability.
avoidWhen: For architectures drawn as diagrams across the full width → use `architecture-tabs`.
For a scroll-driven walkthrough of more features → use `feature-scroll`.
related: media-tabs` — the timed tabs this section renders through.
illustration` — the scene each tab shows.
bestPractices: Keep to three tabs; tabs past the limit are not rendered.
Give every tab an `illustrationLabel` saying what its picture shows.
